# Import the data
#library(readxl)

# mysheets <- read_excel_allsheets("C:/Users/haidong/Documents/Yale/Gregg/Projects/Connecticut/Data/OCME_2009-2019_20210115.xlsx")
# ocme <- plyr::ldply(mysheets, data.frame)
ocme <- read.csv("ocme_2020.csv")

#str(ocme)
#ocme$.id <- NULL
# keep the numeric identifier associated with each case, remove the associated name
ocme$id <- substr(ocme$OCME.Case.Number, start=1, stop=8)
# remove NAs and duplicates
ocme <- ocme[which(!is.na(ocme$id)),]
ocme <- ocme[!duplicated(ocme$id),] 


# exaYear# exact those without geocoding
keepcols = c("id", "Year", "Residence.Address1", "ct_residence.2.HOMELESS.777.UNK", "Residence.City",	"Residence.County",
             "Residence.State",	"Residence.Zip", "injury.locn_revised",	"injury.location_details", "Injury.Address1",
             "Injury.City",	"Injury.County", "Injury.State", "Injury.Zip", "death.locn_details", "death.locn_revised",
             "Death.Address1",	"Death.City",	"Death.County",	"Death.State",	"Death.Zip",
             "ResidenceLatitude",	"ResidenceLongitude",	"InjuryLatitude", "InjuryLongitude", "DeathLatitude", "DeathLongitude")
keepcols1 = c("ResidenceLatitude",	"ResidenceLongitude",	"InjuryLatitude", "InjuryLongitude", "DeathLatitude", "DeathLongitude")

# create a subset of ocme with just the location information
ocme_address1 <- ocme[,keepcols]

# select out columns with missing geocoordinates
ocme_misscordinate1 <- ocme_address1[!complete.cases(ocme_address1[,keepcols1]),]
head(ocme_misscordinate1)

# geocoding those without geocoding process -- have to specify tidygeocoder::geocode for now because otherwise r tries to use the ggplot geocode
ocme_misscordinate1 <- select(ocme_misscordinate1, -c("ResidenceLatitude",	"ResidenceLongitude",	"InjuryLatitude", "InjuryLongitude", "DeathLatitude", "DeathLongitude"))
ocme_geocode2 <- ocme_misscordinate1 %>%
  tidygeocoder::geocode(street = Residence.Address1, city = Residence.City, state = Residence.State, postalcode = Residence.Zip,
          method = 'census', lat=ResidenceLatitude, long=ResidenceLongitude) %>%
  tidygeocoder::geocode(street = Injury.Address1, city = Injury.City, state = Injury.State, postalcode = Injury.Zip,
          method = 'census', full_results = TRUE, lat=InjuryLatitude, long=InjuryLongitude) %>%
  tidygeocoder::geocode(street = Death.Address1, city = Death.City, state = Death.State, postalcode = Death.Zip,
          method = 'census', lat=DeathLatitude, long=DeathLongitude)
sum(is.na(ocme_geocode2$InjuryLatitude))
sum(is.na(ocme_geocode2$ResidenceLongitude))
sum(is.na(ocme_geocode2$DeathLongitude))

subset(ocme_geocode2, is.na(ocme_geocode2$InjuryLatitude))
